assessments.assessment_name: Verbal Behavior Milestones Assessment and Placement Program

skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Generalized across 3 settings and 2 communication partners

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Initiates greetings with peers without prompting
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Responds to peer greetings at 70%, but initiations remain low

behavior_reduction_targets.operational_definition: Leaving the designated area (therapy room, classroom, or caregiver-defined boundary) without permission, defined as moving more than 3 feet beyond the boundary without adult approval

hours_utilization.explanation_if_low: Family had scheduling conflicts during October due to medical appointments for sibling

treatment_goals.goal_statement: Client will independently mand for 30 different items/activities across 3 settings with 80% accuracy over 3 consecutive sessions
treatment_goals.baseline_performance: Client manded for 8 items with physical prompts in 1 setting
treatment_goals.current_performance: Client independently mands for 22 items across 2 settings
treatment_goals.target_criterion: 80% accuracy across 3 consecutive sessions in 3 settings

caregiver_training.caregiver_skill_acquisition: Caregiver demonstrates correct use of 3-step prompting hierarchy with 85% fidelity
caregiver_training.barriers_to_participation: Scheduling conflicts in October reduced sessions from planned 12 to 8

measurable_criteria: Elopement frequency below 0.5 per hour for 4 consecutive weeks
Mastery of 80% of current skill acquisition targets
Caregiver implementation fidelity above 90% across all trained procedures
VB-MAPP scores within 1 standard deviation of age-matched peers in Mand and Tact domains
discharge_plan.transition_plan: Step-down to 15 hours/week consultation model with monthly BCBA oversight
discharge_plan.current_discharge_readiness: Client has met 1 of 4 discharge criteria. Continued intensive services recommended.

clinical_justification_for_hours: Client continues to demonstrate progress but has not yet met treatment goals. Reduction in hours not recommended at this time due to active behavior reduction targets and emerging social skills requiring intensive intervention.
